channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-50522 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2015-4852 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Oracle WebLogic Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within Apache Commons, which can allow for for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-25297 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

item.title: CVE-2017-6744 — Cisco IOS software
item.description: Threat Signal 59. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS 1 contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code on an affected system or cause an affected system to reload. An attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a crafted SNMP packet to an affected system via IPv4 or IPv6.

item.title: CVE-2008-3431 — Oracle VirtualBox
item.description: Threat Signal 59. An input validation vulnerability exists in the VBoxDrv.sys driver of Sun xVM VirtualBox which allows attackers to locally execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2021-30661 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit Storage contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-30666 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS WebKit contains a buffer-overflow vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-30665 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-30663 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and Safari WebKit contain an integer overflow vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-28664 — Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) kernel driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain write access to read-only memory, gain root privilege, corrupt memory, and modify the memory of other processes.

item.title: CVE-2020-16013 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an inappropriate implementation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2021-30554 — Google Chromium WebGL
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Google Chromium WebGL contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-0878 — Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2020-0986 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Windows kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling objects in memory that allows attackers to escalate privileges and execute code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2021-27085 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-8468 — Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan and Worry-Free Business Security Agents
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security agents contain a content validation escape vulnerability that could allow an attacker to manipulate certain agent client components.

item.title: CVE-2021-36741 — Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to upload files.

item.title: CVE-2026-67279 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

item.title: CVE-2026-68820 — Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2026-56155 — Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2026-34926 — Trend Micro Apex One
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Trend Micro Apex One (on-premise) contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated local attacker to modify a key table on the server to inject malicious code to deploy to agents on affected installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-20122 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manger
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability due to improper file handling on the API interface of an affected system. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by uploading a malicious file on the local file system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to overwrite arbitrary files on the affected system and gain vmanage user privileges.

item.title: CVE-2025-43510 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain an improper locking vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected changes in memory shared between processes.

item.title: CVE-2025-66376 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Classic UI where attackers could abuse Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) @import directives in email HTML.

item.title: CVE-2023-41974 — Apple iOS and iPadOS
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Apple iOS and iPadOS contain a use-after-free vulnerability. An app may be able to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-21385 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a memory corruption vulnerability while using alignments for memory allocation.

item.title: CVE-2026-20700 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Apple iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow an attacker with memory write the capability to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-21514 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Office Word contains a reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2025-54313 — Prettier eslint-config-prettier
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Prettier eslint-config-prettier contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability. Installing an affected package executes an install.js file that launches the node-gyp.dll malware on Windows.

item.title: CVE-2025-48572 — Android Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2025-24990 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows Agere Modem Driver contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain administrator privileges.

item.title: CVE-2025-48543 — Android Runtime
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Android Runtime contains a use-after-free vulnerability potentially allowing a chrome sandbox escape leading to local privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-0386 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Linux Kernel contains an improper ownership management vulnerability, where unauthorized access to the execution of the setuid file with capabilities was found in the Linux kernel’s OverlayFS subsystem in how a user copies a capable file from a nosuid mount into another mount. This uid mapping bug allows a local user to escalate their privileges on the system.

item.title: CVE-2025-27920 — Srimax Output Messenger
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Srimax Output Messenger contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to access sensitive files outside the intended directory, potentially leading to configuration leakage or arbitrary file access.

item.title: CVE-2024-11182 — MDaemon Email Server
item.description: Threat Signal 58. MDaemon Email Server contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to load arbitrary JavaScript code via an HTML e-mail message.

item.title: CVE-2025-3928 — Commvault Web Server
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Commvault Web Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to create and execute webshells.

item.title: CVE-2022-23748 — Audinate Dante Discovery
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Dante Discovery contains a process control vulnerability in mDNSResponder.exe that all allows for a DLL sideloading attack. A local attacker can leverage this vulnerability in the Dante Application Library to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2025-21333 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2022-2586 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Linux Kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the nft_object, allowing local attackers to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-36033 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) Core Library contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-41992 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for local privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-38180 — Microsoft .NET Core and Visual Studio
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft .NET Core and Visual Studio contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2023-32046 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2020-35730 — Roundcube Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Roundcube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows an attacker to send a plain text e-mail message with Javascript in a link reference element that is mishandled by linkref_addinindex in rcube_string_replacer.php.

item.title: CVE-2022-0028 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 58. A Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS URL filtering policy misconfiguration could allow a network-based attacker to conduct reflected and amplified TCP denial-of-service (RDoS) attacks.

item.title: CVE-2017-0005 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 58. The Graphics Device Interface (GDI) in Microsoft Windows allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2016-4655 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 58. The Apple iOS kernel allows attackers to obtain sensitive information from memory via a crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2019-8720 — WebKitGTK WebKitGTK
item.description: Threat Signal 58. WebKitGTK contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-22675 — Apple macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 58. macOS Monterey contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow an application to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-34486 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows Event Tracing contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for privilege escalation.
